The structure of composition Ba4Mg8Sb4 (reduced formula BaMg2Sb) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph is fully 3-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between Mg 10-vertex and Sb 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing among Mg 10-vertex polyhedra.
